instruction: Community link conversion from init.ifc. Open C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc in Archicad and use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png as references while converting it into the required one-storey community link. The init model is a starting shell and must be revised into the specified final spaces, windows, roof, and schedule. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and a tab-delimited zone schedule to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Keep the shaped model envelope approximately within min 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and max 29.0, 13.0, 3.6, with 0.5 m tolerance. The IFC must have unique GlobalId values, exactly one building storey, exactly seven IfcSpace zones, at least four walls, at least two slabs, at least one roof, and at least six windows. Put all zones on the single storey with these zone numbers, names, and areas within +/-0.10 m2: Z01 LINK 20.0 m2; Z02 HALL 84.0 m2; Z03 MEETING-1 48.0 m2; Z04 MEETING-2 48.0 m2; Z05 STORE 12.0 m2; Z06 WC 12.0 m2; Z07 COURTYARD 36.0 m2. The schedule must use headers ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area, list those rows in order, and total between 259.0 and 261.0 m2. Equivalent Archicad or IFC export internals, object names, relationship structure, materials, and property sets may vary; the required result is the stated BIM model and deliverables, not a byte-for-byte copy of the teacher IFC. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
